title: Differentiated normality estimate ‖D(ψ∘g)(x)‖ ≤ 1 + 2ab|x − ψ(g(x))|
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Euclid d) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (Q : Euclid d → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen O → x ∈ O → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ (g x) → DifferentiableAt ℝ Q (g x) → (∀ z ∈ O, Q (g z) (z - ψ (g z)) = 0) → (Q (g x)).comp (fderiv ℝ ψ (g x)) = fderiv ℝ ψ (g x) → ‖Q (g x)‖ ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → ‖fderiv ℝ Q (g x)‖ ≤ a → (∀ w : Euclid d, ‖w‖ ≤ b * ‖fderiv ℝ ψ (g x) w‖) → a * b * ‖x - ψ (g x)‖ ≤ 1 / 2 → ‖fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ g) x‖ ≤ 1 + 2 * (a * b) * ‖x - ψ (g x)‖
